primitives.name: Game-script rush-volume decay
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Fix 1 — Game-script rush-volume decay (Jacobs OVER 60.5 rush LOSS root cause) **Problem:** GB led 20-10 (Q2) then 27-10 (Q3) and abandoned the run — Jacobs 16 carries, 33 yards, 2.1 YPC.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'v_{rush}^{decay}(t)': 'rush_attempt_volume at time t (dimensionless)', 'v_{rush}^{base}': 'base rush_attempt_volume (dimensionless)', 'f_{decay}(scoreDiff, quarter)': 'decay_multiplier function (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes rushing volume is a decreasing function of score differential and quarter.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when score differential drops below 7 points or during early game stages.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a multiplicative adjustment in the probability of rushing plays in the GSE simulator.
layer2.telemetry: Difference in rush_attempt_volume between simulated and actual game logs during blowouts.

primitives.name: Red-zone TD rate vs FG stall parameter
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Fix 2 — Red-zone TD rate vs FG stall parameter (GB TT UNDER 25.5 LOSS root cause) **Problem:** GB scored TDs on all 3 red-zone trips (3-3), CAR settled for FG on 1 of 2 (1-2).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'P(TD|zone)': 'Probability of touchdown given being in the redzone (dimensionless)', 'redzone_{td\\_pct}': 'Team-specific redzone touchdown conversion rate (dimensionless)', 'P(FG\\_stall)': 'Probability of stalling to a field goal (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes TD conversion in the redzone is a binary outcome biased by a fixed parameter.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when redzone_{td_pct} approaches zero or one, indicating perfect conversion.

layer2.mapping: Maps to a separate parameter for redzone TD conversion in the GSI conformal inference framework.
layer2.telemetry: Bias in predicted redzone efficiency compared to observed TD rates in high-leverage situations.

primitives.name: IDP snap-count haircut
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Fix 3 — IDP snap-count haircut (Okereke/McDuffie/Nixon root causes) **Problem:** Okereke OVER 6.5 T+A lost (4 tackles), McDuffie UNDER 8.5 T+A lost (10 tackles), Nixon OVER 4.5 lost (2 tackles).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'T_{IDP}': 'Projected IDP tackle count (dimensionless)', 'snapCount_{team)': 'Total defensive snaps for the team (dimensionless)', 'tackleRate_{player)': 'Player-specific tackle rate per snap (dimensionless)', 'f_{haircut}(clockControl)': 'haircut_multiplier function based on clock control (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Assumes tackle counts scale linearly with defensive snaps and player efficiency, modified by game script.

primitives.name: Sack tandem gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: --## Fix 3 — IDP snap-count haircut (Okereke/McDuffie/Nixon root causes) **Problem:** Okereke OVER 6.5 T+A lost (4 tackles), McDuffie UNDER 8.5 T+A lost (10 tackles), Nixon OVER 4.5 lost (2 tackles).
